name: Youbaku Kitan Apocalypsis
original_name: 妖縛奇譚アポカリプス
source:
Aya Nagaoka, a psychic girl who came to the village to perform an exorcism, and Kunihiko Nishina, a reporter who came to cover the exorcism.
Every night, the two of them have the same dream.
...In it, Kunihiko continuously rapes Aya in an abandoned house.
As the day of the exorcism approaches, Aya grows increasingly exhausted.
Kunihiko begins to believe that this is the role he has been forced to play to prevent the exorcism.
...And then, the day of the exorcism arrives.
The dream becomes reality.
